name: Claude Overnight
description: Run a local Claude Code session unattended overnight: spawn `claude -p`, auto-resume after 5h rate-limit windows, report progress to Telegram.

projectCwd.description: Absolute path to the project directory where `claude` runs. Falls back to env OPENCLAW_CLAUDE_BRIDGE_CWD.

claudeBin.description: Name or absolute path of the claude CLI binary.

allowedTools.description: Comma-separated allow-list passed to `claude --allowed-tools`. Supervisor runs without the OpenClaw perm-hook (no human in the loop overnight), so this is the only gate.

stateDir.description: Directory for per-sid state files. Falls back to <projectCwd>/.openclaw/overnight.

maxIterations.description: Safety cap on continue-loop iterations to prevent runaway.

rateLimitFallbackSleepSec.description: When rate-limit is detected but no retry-after parseable, sleep this long (5h05m by default).

iterationTimeoutMs.description: Hard cap per single `claude -p` call (kill on timeout). 1h default.
